faq.title: You may be wondering…
faq.intro: Answers to the most common questions about the Reboot.

items.a: The Reboot is the new entry point to the HASHCODE community. You build your profile in 2 minutes, get a first orientation, and join the official community. It is the first step of the new HASHCODE.
About 2 minutes. Most answers are one click. We only ask what is needed to understand your profile — nothing superfluous.

items.q: Do I need to be an expert to join?
items.a: No. HASHCODE is open to beginners, students, developers, professionals, founders and self-taught people. We start where you really are.
Yes. The Reboot is free: profile + community access. If a paid option ever exists, it will be optional and clearly announced. Nothing is charged, nothing is hidden.

items.q: What happens after I sign up?
items.a: You answer with one click (~2 min), get your suggested track, then your WhatsApp access if your profile is compatible. Otherwise we contact you by email for a personal invitation. Zero spam, deleted with one message.
Yes. We collect the minimum necessary, no resale, no advertising. You can request deletion of your data at any time.

whatAreCookies.title: What are cookies?
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small text files placed on your device (computer, phone) when visiting a website. They allow recognizing your browser, remembering your preferences, and analyzing site usage.

list.name: Essential (strictly necessary)
list.desc: Essential for site operation. Cannot be disabled.
cookies: auth_token: magic link/OTP auth token (expires: 15 min)

list.name: Analytics (optional, with consent)
list.desc: Measure audience in a privacy-respecting way (Plausible, no third-party cookies, anonymized data).

consent.title: Consent
consent.content1: Essential cookies are placed automatically (legal basis: legitimate interest / contract performance).
consent.content2: Analytics and functional cookies are only placed after your explicit consent (banner on first visit). You can withdraw consent at any time.
consent.content3: Refusing optional cookies does not prevent access to services.

manage.title: Manage preferences

browsers: Edge: Settings → Cookies and site permissions

thirdParty.content2: These services have their own privacy policies. We do not control their cookies.
services: Resend / Brevo (email): open/click tracking cookies (transactional emails only)
Plausible (analytics): anonymous cookies, no personal data
WhatsApp (invitation link): WhatsApp/Meta cookies if you click the link

retention.title: Retention periods
retention.content: Cookies expire automatically according to the durations indicated above. You can delete them manually at any time.
durations: Session cookies: deleted on browser close
Authentication cookies: 15 minutes (OTP code) to 30 days (member session)
